sinopsis.es: Principios de los años 2000, Colombia. El comandante Montoya, al frente de la lucha contra las FARC, reúne a sus tropas para celebrar su ascenso a general. Pero, al caer la noche, una violenta tormenta interrumpe la fiesta.
sinopsis.en: It's 2003. The Thunder Platoon, a group of Colombian army soldiers between the ages of 18 and 23, is celebrating its latest combat victory at a farm in the tropics: they have killed nine suspected guerrillas. Under the blazing sun, amid laughter, music, and alcohol, they are also celebrating that their commander, Montoya, will soon be decorated for his tireless work in the fight against "terrorism."
